editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when your favorite mutant ninjas stumble upon a weird piece of tech that rips open the fabric of reality? You get a wild ride that feels like a Saturday morning cartoon on steroids. The group finds a strange artifact that flings them across different eras and alien worlds, forcing them to work together while dealing with a lot of chaos. It is a lighthearted adventure that captures the brotherhood of the turtles perfectly, mixing their classic humor with some pretty cool sci-fi concepts that keep you guessing where they will land next.

The animation is bright and snappy, and the action scenes move at a breakneck speed that never feels boring. While the plot is a bit simple and some of the jokes are for kids, the heart of the story is what really makes it work. You should definitely check this out if you need something fun to watch with the family.
endingExplained: After jumping through several dimensions, the turtles realize the artifact is unstable and could destroy everything. They team up to trigger a final blast of energy that sends them screaming back to their own time in New York City. They manage to destroy the device just in time to stop a villain from using it. The movie wraps up with the brothers sharing a pizza, happy to be home and glad the time-traveling madness is finally over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves the TMNT crew and goofy sci-fi adventures.
